title: Wars In All World: an interactive research atlas of recorded wars
description: Interactive research atlas of recorded wars (Map, Globe and Numbers views) built from HCED v3, Correlates of War (inter-, extra-, non- and intra-state wars; MIDLOC v2.1), The War Atlas and UCDP GED 26.1. A reproducible Python pipeline merges wars across sources (with a merge-precision audit, see data/processed/qa/merge_audit_summary.json), applies documented per-record source corrections, records SHA-256 checksums of every input, and validates the exported catalog before deployment. Not a complete history of all wars; coverage limits are reported in the app.
notes: Code: MIT. Derived catalog data (data/processed, app/public/data): CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA). Source datasets keep their own licenses; cite them as listed in app/public/data/citations.json.
